Agencies across Kentucky are accepting applications for the Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program Fall Subsidy. Applications close Dec. 18, or when funding is depleted.  "/> Top Story Kentucky LIHEAP Fall Subsidy applications open Elizabeth Crider Elizabeth Crider Author email Nov 9, 2026 Nov 9, 2026 Updated 5 hrs ago Facebook Twitter WhatsApp SMS Email Facebook Twitter WhatsApp SMS Email Print Copy article link Save PADUCAH — Community Action Agencies across Kentucky are accepting applications for the Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program Fall Subsidy. Applications close Dec. 18, or when funding is depleted.  Contributed According to a release from the Community Action Council, assistance will be provided on a first-come, first-served basis.  Interested households should contact the Community Action Agency serving their county to determine eligibility and apply. To qualify, households must meet program eligibility requirements, including having a household income at or below 150 percent of the Federal Poverty Guidelines.  All applicants will be required to provide the following documentation at the time of application:  Proof of Social Security Number or Permanent Resident Card for each member of the household.  Proof of household income (all members) from the prior month. Most current heating bill, or statement from landlord if heating expenses are included in rent, or statement from utility company if the household participates in a Pre-Pay Electric Program.  The account number and for main heating fuel sources and electric bill.  LIHEAP Fall Subsidy does not require a disconnect notice, a past due bill, or eviction notice and may be applied as credit to the household's account, per a release. Once an application is approved, a onetime benefit is paid directly to the utility company.  For more information about LIHEAP, click here.   Facebook Twitter WhatsApp SMS Email Print Copy article link Save Tags Federal Assistance In The United States Low-income Home Energy Assistance Program Energy Economics Paducah, Kentucky Kentucky Community Action Agency Kentucky Liheap Fall Community Action Council Elizabeth Crider Author email Follow Elizabeth Crider Close Get email notifications on {{subject}} daily!
